context: Request: past patent-infringement matters where the firm retained a technical expert, with the documents showing each retention. Rubric: 1007-00003 (Vantage Mobility; litigation-status-memo.docx), 1014-00003 (Optiwave v. Lumos), 1014-00004 (Optiwave v. Lumicore), 1037-00004 (Solstice Biomedical), proof documents for each, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for request words; the hit list holds only emails.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Four globs over file names for expert, report, disclosure and technical.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Four batches of reads of retention letters, reports and memos: first the two matters with expert-engagement folders, then expert documents of about ten more matters; nothing from one matter whose file names had matched.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs the expert folders and all files of the two matters it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters as the only qualifying ones.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One qualifying matter never surfaced (its grep reached only emails) and another surfaced in its first searches but was never opened; the answer names two of four.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its content grep only reached email text, and neither it nor the file-name globs listed one qualifying matter whose evidence sits in a memo; it never searched document text.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The grep and file-name globs listed another qualifying matter's expert and claim-construction files, but across four reading batches it never opened that matter.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find (empty).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for request words plus a repeat of the whole-store glob; the hit list holds only emails.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Two find | grep runs over file paths for expert and litigation words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of reads of retention agreements, memos, a complaint and reports from seven matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Grep for an expert's name and expert words within one candidate matter; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Single reads of retention letters from four matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters, flagging one as evidenced only indirectly by a work-product memo.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: All four matters were named, but for one it cited an assessment memo instead of the document recording the expert's retention, which it never found.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: Its grep inside the matter whose expert it had seen only in an assessment memo returned nothing (the grep did not read document text), and it did not list that matter's files, so the status memo recording the retention was never found.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep; the hit list holds only emails.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Five globs over file names (one capitalised variant returns nothing).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads retention agreements, prep memos and complaints from three matters; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Script over all expert-, retention- or engagement-named documents printing the opening of those that mention patent litigation or a technical expert.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs all files of the three matters already read.

stages.stage: Write the response
tags: run ended: text reply without finish
stages.note: Writes three matters; the run then ends with a text reply and no finish call.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Write the response
runs.failure_point: A fourth qualifying matter appeared in its scan output but was never opened; the answer names three of four.

first_error.why: The scan just before printed the engagement letter of a fourth patent-defence matter, but it then listed only the three matters it had already read and never opened that one.

divergence: All three runs found the same three matters through file-name searches of expert folders and differ on the fourth, whose evidence sits only in a memo. T0 never surfaced it (its grep reached only emails; search miss) and also never opened a second matter its searches listed. T2's late scan surfaced it, but it then listed only the matters it had already read (surfaced, not opened). T1 opened the fourth matter through an assessment memo, but its in-matter grep returned nothing, so it cited that memo instead of the document recording the retention (search miss within the matter).
